email.subject: Welcome to Johns Hopkins University Careers
email.body:
Hi, Welcome to Johns Hopkins University (JHU) Jobs!
Here is a checklist for you
Build a rich profile
Add all your experiences, education, skills, projects, and courses to fully
                                                represent yourself!
Update Profile
Understand your job matches
Jobs that match 

                                               your career pathway based on your profile.
Track your applications
View the real-time status of all your submitted applications.
Set custom alerts
Be the first to know about new job opportunities. Get meaningful alerts
                                                for recommended jobs directly into your inbox.
